sentences.text: We live near the sea.
I play in the park.
The line is so long.
Mum makes hot food for us. It sits on the heat for an hour. She adds just a bit of salt. We eat it all up.
I have a plan for my big day. I note it all on a list. I hope for lots of fun and luck!
We jump on the bed.
I hide by the door.
We run up the hill.
My name is on my cup. Dad has one just the same. The big one is his and the red one is mine.
It is race day at the park! I run past the pond and up the hill. My leg hurts a bit but I win! I jump for joy at the end.
I make a big cake.
I like my new toy.
I can hear the band.
The moon is high up in the dark sky. It is late and I must rest. Papa reads one last page of the book and I kiss him. It was a good day.
I found a nest in a hole near the path. The bird needs to be safe. I move away and let it be.
The rain fell on my head.
The rock is by the pond.
My room is big and nice.
We play a fun game at home. I hide in a huge box and keep my head down. Dad looks all over and can not find me!
I had an idea for a toy boat with a red sail! We let it go on the pond. We saw it rise and fall, rise and fall. It did not go down at all! I kept my boat by my bed.
He came last in the race.
I have a plan to win!
I just hope you can come!
The poor cat was lost. We put up a post to help find it. A good man saw the mark on its neck and its pink nose. He came to us with the cat in his arms. I am so glad to have it back!
Mama and I buy milk and meat at the sale. I hold the bag all the way back. I love to help. Mama says we make a good pair!
I see a rose on the path.
I note the date on the page.
I pick a pink hat for her.
Once the rain stops, I know we can take a bus ride along the long road to the shop. We pass the park and see more roses before we pick one for Mum.
The main rule of the game is to be fair. I said it out loud so all can hear. If I lose a game, it is fine and I mean it.
Do you mind if I sit here?
Once the rain ends, we can go out.
Mama and I made a cake!
I pull out a roll of rope from my bag and tie it on the big rock. We make a fine camp by the lake. Our coats are hung on a line to dry.

My cat is part of my life. I like to lift my cat onto the bed and rest next to it. I also save a bit of food for my cat. It used to sit by me if I sang. Some say a cat has nine lives. I hope it is so. My cat has left me, and I miss him so much.
I hold my baby cat.
Only dad can lift the big box.
I know the rule of the game.
My room is in a big mess. I pack my toys into the store and open the door to air the room.
The king in my book is a good king. He leads his men over many miles and he meets a kind lady along the way.
